title: Readability Comparison of AI-Generated Versus UpToDate Educational Content on Stroke Management: A Cross-Sectional Study

live_model.evidence: "Educational content aimed at medical professionals was generated using ChatGPT (GPT-4o, accessed on May 27, 2025), developed by OpenAI."

prompt.location: Methods: "The following standardized prompt was used: 'Write an educational guide for medical professionals on stroke, including definition, clinical features, diagnosis, and treatment options.'"
prompt.note: "Default model settings, including temperature, were used" - via the ChatGPT consumer interface, not the API.

claim.metric: Flesch Reading Ease Score (FRES) of AI-generated stroke guide
claim.location: Results tables comparing one ChatGPT-generated document to one UpToDate section

data.source: UpToDate stroke section (subscription resource, but cited/described); single ChatGPT output reproduced in the paper

notes: Generated via the ChatGPT consumer web app ("accessed", default settings), not the API, and "GPT-4o" is undated with an access date (2025-05-27) after the 2024-10-02 cutoff, so it cannot be pinned to gpt-4o-2024-05-13. Only a single generated document (n=1) underlies the readability comparison. GPT-4 Turbo appears elsewhere only as a generic background mention (role C).
